answers.core:
If it's a wrapper around `AStar`, then the path cost will still be calculated twice (first when AStar pathfinding, second when wrapper computes it based on the pathfinding result).

It defeats the purpose of enhancing `AStar` if the plugin provides its own A* implementation.
answers.workaround: Iterate through the returned path and repeat the same logic as AStar to compute the total cost.

title: Add a way to get path cost from AStar
